title: Human bottleneck reset event 70,000 years ago

tellings.quote: Well, there there are people who feel strongly that there have been reset events, right? Human history reset events. For instance, 70,000 years ago, we know genomically there was a bottleneck.

plain: About 70,000 years ago, human numbers crashed so low that our genes still show it, and some people see this as one of several "reset events" in human history. A speaker identified only as Jack raises it without naming a source, saying "we know genomically there was a bottleneck", meaning a narrow squeeze in the population. If true, it would mean human history may have been wiped back and restarted more than once.
